name: democratic-republic-of-congo-drc-local-roads-openstreetmap-export
notes:
République démocratique du Congo (RDC), Réseau routier local

Lines + Polygons : Local roads Interactive Online Map

[OSM Roads](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:highway)
Columns: osm_id,  highway,  name,  layer,  bridge,  tunnel,  oneway,  ref ,  route,  junction,  lanes,  width,  maxspeed,  surface,  practicability, smoothness, condition, geometry

OSM Filter

    highway in ('residential', 'living_street', 'path', 'footway', 'pedestrian', 'steps', 'cycleway', 'track', 'service', 'bridleway', 'construction', 'road')

* highway=road attribute for roads not yet classified.

The  Major Roads dataset is available from the  [Major Roads network dataset](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/democratic-republic-of-congo-drc-major-roads-network-openstreetmap-export)
